steps.text: Talk to Trufitus in his house located north-east of Tai Bwo Wannai. Everytime you gather a new herb you need to go show it to Trufitus before being able to get a new kind of a herb.
chat: 3. It's a nice village, where is everyone?
1. It sounds like just the challenge for me.

steps.text: Go south-west of Tai Bwo Wannai until green and yellow vines labelled 'marshy jungle vine' are seen.
Search the vines and clean the herb. Your character may spend several minutes finding a herb.
Note: Take three if you intend to do Legends' Quest and Zogre Flesh Eaters.
Talk to Trufitus. Make sure you cleaned the herb.
Head north-east from Trufitus. There will be Harpie Bug Swarms and palm trees.
Search the palm trees and clean the herb.
Note: Take two if you intend to do Legends' Quest.
Talk to Trufitus.
To the direct south of Tai Bwo Wannai Village is a patch of scorched earth.
Search the scorched earth (the squares immediately next to the fire) for the herb and clean it.
Talk to Trufitus.
Go south-east from Trufitus until you reach the Karamja Jungle mine, marked with a pickaxe on minimap.
Search the rocks for the herb and clean it.
Note: Take two if you intend to do Fairytale I - Growing Pains (possible required item).
Talk to Trufitus.

sections.title: Rogue's purse
notes: Note: The Rogue's purse must be obtained from the following method. Herbs gained anywhere else cannot be used.

steps.text: Go back by the Harpie Bug Swarms and head north-west until a cave is seen over the cavern. Search the rocks and enter the cave.

In the cave, head south, look for green spots on the wall labelled 'Fungus covered Cavern wall', then search them and clean the herb. This process may take up to a minute. Do not try to use a Rogue's purse dropped by a Jogre. It must be obtained via searching the wall.
Note: Take two if you intend to do Zogre Flesh Eaters.
Killing a Jogre inside this cave completes an easy Karamja Diary task, and is worth doing along the way.
Talk to Trufitus.
Congratulations, quest complete!
